name: LearnWorlds
summary: Create, sell and scale online courses. Build a branded school with interactive video, assessments, certificates and a built-in checkout.
best_for: course creators and training businesses that want a branded school with interactive video, assessments, certificates and a built-in checkout
skip_if: you sell only occasional courses (a lighter or transaction-fee-only platform may cost less) or you just need to host a few videos behind a paywall
honest_knock: The detail most people miss is Starter's $5-per-paid-enrollment fee — at any real sales volume it quietly makes Starter more expensive than the flat Pro Trainer plan, so the "cheap" tier often isn't. Starter also runs on a single admin seat and 24/5 email support against 24/7 above it, and the branded mobile app is a separate add-on whose price the pricing page no longer states. Price it against your expected enrollment volume, not the sticker.

plans.name: Starter

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-29 on their own pricing page, both billing toggles) Starter $49/mo (or $44 annually) with a $5 fee per paid enrollment — still the single most important number in this ladder; Pro Trainer $99/mo, or $79 billed annually, with no enrollment fee; Learning Center $299/mo, or $249 annually; Corporate quoted. The High Volume tier we recorded in August is gone: the ladder is now Starter, Pro Trainer, Learning Center and Corporate. Annual billing saves 20% and the trial is 30 days. Limits published alongside: 1,000 / 2,000 / 2,000 monthly active learners, 1 / 5 / 25 admins, 300 / 500 / 1,000 AI credits a month, email support 24/5 on Starter against 24/7 above it, and a 99.90% uptime commitment (99.95% on Corporate). All prices exclude VAT, which is added for EU customers unless a valid EU VAT number is given, and your payment gateway (Stripe at about 2.9% + $0.30) charges on top regardless of tier. A branded mobile app is still a separate add-on, but the page now lists it as having multiple price options and prints no amount, so the roughly $149/mo we carried in August is no longer confirmable. Two reading notes: the page opens by asking which of four goals brings you there and recommends a plan on that basis — the figures above were read with the branded-academy goal selected — and the plan cards print their numbers with no currency symbol at all, the only dollar signs on the page sitting on the $5 enrollment fee and the Stripe example. On 2026-09-30 every amount, limit and uptime figure above was unchanged. That day the page also ran a Q4 promotion, 15% off monthly billing for six months on Pro Trainer (84.15 instead of 99) and Learning Center (254.15 instead of 299), stated to end on 30 September 2026 at 11:59 PM PDT. On 2026-10-01 the pricing page moved that deadline to 5 October 2026 at 11:59 PM PDT; it is a short promotion, so do not budget on it. On 2026-10-29 LearnWorlds raised Starter from $29 a month ($24 annually) to $49 ($44 annually) for new Starter subscriptions, trial users who upgrade to Starter and customers who downgrade to it; existing Starter subscribers keep their old price while they stay on the plan. Pro Trainer, Learning Center and the $5 enrollment fee were unchanged that day.

claims.observed: No card was requested according to source notes, and no payment details were entered in the observed route. Complete signup screens were not counted.

claims.observed: Starter monthly EUR 49 amount due shown; VAT unspecified, and EUR 5 per paid enrollment is a separate usage charge. No matching rule.
claims.comparability: Starter monthly page and amount due both show EUR 49, but the hidden VAT basis and enrollment usage fee and absent cost rule prevent a verified all-in comparison.
claims.buying_consequence: EUR 49 monthly excludes a verified VAT determination; each paid enrollment is listed at EUR 5.

exit_test.what: Created two fictional learners manually during Trial and exported the complete users report, including the owner.
exit_test.awkward: Add user always sends an invitation in the inspected form: no off switch was present, and the first example.com address became Hard bounced. The export has no hard-bounce column. A second tag was not successfully created, so preservation of the complete two-tag kit is untested. Custom fields were not entered and User fields was not opened. Starter lists a charge per paid enrollment in addition to its monthly fee.

friction.export_route: Users > All users > Export users report > Export as csv.
friction.format: UTF-8 CSV with BOM, forty-seven columns and three rows: the owner plus the two test learners.
friction.reimport: Import users is a higher-plan feature on Trial. The disabled update-existing option describes email matching; no reimport was performed.
friction.cancellation: Actual cancellation, trial expiry and account deletion were not tested.

not_tested: Complete signup screen count and human first-result setup time.
Actual cancellation, expiry, deletion and follow-up mail.
Kit fields that were not entered.
came_along: Both learner IDs, names with accents, emails and the single entered aibm-test tag appear in the CSV.
exit_test.note: A check of this export route with synthetic records, on the account and date stated. Re-importing the export was not tested. Friction is described, not scored; this is not a verdict on the product.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 30 October 2026 on the free trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We added two made-up learners by hand, exported the user list and looked at bulk import and the paid plans.
findings: The trial showed 30 days, with no card. Setup asks you to pick a site template and answer five questions.
Adding a user always sends that person an invitation email; the form has no option to skip it. Our test address bounced within a minute.
The user export is a CSV with 47 columns. It brought back each learner's ID, name with accents, email and tag.
Bulk user import is locked on the trial. The locked form shows an option to update existing users, matched by email.
Starter was €49 a month plus €5 per paid enrollment on the monthly term. The checkout showed €49.00 due, with no tax line before the card details.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
